title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1973-12-01

ai_review.summary: Matrix source with decent clarity but slight wobble captures a mixed‑energy 1973 show highlighted by a hot Mexicali Blues and a joyous Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad.
ai_review.review: The Gardner matrix tape offers clearer sound than other available sources, though it has a little wobble, pitch‑correction needs and some wow‑flutter. Musically the concert sits in the middle of the Wang Theater run – the first set is flat early on, while the second set picks up with strong moments like Mexicali Blues, They Love Each Other, Me & My Uncle and an exuberant Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad, but fire‑code interruptions break the flow.

ai_rating.rationale: Review gives a moderate 3‑star overall rating; performance is average with several highlights, and recording quality is decent but has noted wobble and pitch issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix provides better width/hall with slight wobble; Gardner source clearer than Clugston but needs -1% pitch correction; Miller version adds wow & flutter from transport fluctuation.

standout_songs: Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set starts flat and stays below average; second set is broken by fire‑code interruptions and banter but gains momentum after They Love Each Other.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Races the tempo early, starts Uncle John's Band in a different key/scale, and delivers strong, firing guitar work throughout the second set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Backs into Keith's hot‑rod energy on Mexicali Blues; later appears to forget lyrics during Me & My Uncle.
band_member_comments.Keys: Provides hot‑rod keyboard drive supporting the band; no specific issues noted.
